# Fetch all venmo friends (paginated)
venmo_friends = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=venmo_login['access_token'], page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if isinstance(page, dict) and 'message' in page:
        print("Error fetching venmo friends:", page)
        break
    venmo_friends.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total venmo friends fetched: {len(venmo_friends)}")
print("First few:", venmo_friends[:3])
